note: Repositories under the crypto-lab-* name that are NOT fleet subjects. Read by tools/sibling-labs.js, which excludes them from enumeration and PRINTS them with the reason, and by .github/workflows/fleet.yml, which drops them from the clone list. One definition for local runs and CI: a name here is excluded in both places or in neither. This list is deliberately tiny and deliberately NOT a catch-all for unpinned directories, because a genuinely new lab must still fail dispatch-sync as UNPINNED-LAB rather than vanish.

excluded.reason: The owner's private Fleet Console (dashboard and login pages), not an exhibit. It carries no card, is in no census, and must not be added to either. Do not edit this repository.
excluded.evidence: gh repo view says visibility=PRIVATE. It appeared as a local clone on 2026-11-07 and immediately failed theme-sync on public/dashboard.html and public/login.html for having no data-theme, and dispatch-sync for having no census pin -- two findings about a repository that is not a subject of either checker.
excluded.whyNotCisRule: CI excluded it only because secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN is scoped to this repository and cannot list the owner's private repos. CI's own filter is `gh repo list ... startswith("crypto-lab-")`, which DOES return crypto-lab-fleet when run with a credential that can see it -- measured 2026-11-08. So CI's exclusion was an accident of token visibility rather than a definition, and adopting it as the source of truth would have made fleet membership depend on which token ran the job.
